scope: Actual pending NP HTTP create/rename/delete; no application geometry
notes: Compatibility baseline bypasses only the new native adapter; same current process and endpoints.
Native owner/target prefix and retained rows are built before measurement, never copied from candidate geometry.
The larger background is a 64-cell, 126bp native bundle plus 16 thiol handles and 16 retained candidate rows.
Every measured template must pass unchanged ordinary node/byte admission; no fixture shrinking or retries.
Common recovery and metadata reconciliation remain inside the existing recording lock.
No source proof is required for UI recording; fresh-worker proof is measured once per native case afterward.
No limits, GC policy, physics, retry behavior or production sessions are changed.

diagnostics.scope: Benchmark-only correlation; all GC policy and runtime limits unchanged

latency_status: Unqualified: this harness records timings but applies no latency acceptance threshold.
exit_status_basis: Correctness and cleanup only; a zero exit does not qualify latency.
evidence_retention: Full action timings, bounds, cold statuses, all errors and cleanup retained. Per-request diagnostics aggregated by action/mode; retained every generation-2 overlap and each action maximum request/recording-lock/light sample. Other raw samples and generated dependency identity maps pruned after review. GC overlap is wall-clock correlation, not causation or removable user latency; per-leaf timings include any GC pauses.
diagnostic_observations: All 450 measured native requests called each of the three native leaves once; legacy requests called none. No diagnostic events were dropped.

Larger native median requests were 20.10–21.24 ms versus compatibility 17.26–17.89 ms. The prior uninstrumented native run was 23.38–24.12 ms; these are sequential observations, not a randomized causal estimate.
Larger native median leaf total was 2.87–2.90 ms. Generation-2 pauses overlapped some typed-ownership leaves, other native recording work, and work outside the recording lock.

Maximum native request was 75.79 ms. Its generation-2 event was phase other and recording lock 15.88 ms; another native request held the lock 70.13 ms during a generation-2 overlap. Compatibility also had generation-2 overlaps and a 74.94 ms request.
Latency remains unqualified. No GC policy, retry, runtime, reference-work, capture, transport or recovery limits changed.
